dkt-1938-p002.notes: Page 2 of 8 of Dkt. 1938 (Case 1:18-cv-05587, PageID 127941), numbered paragraphs 2-5(b) of the Receiver's motion. Key qualifiers for the $30,000 figure: the Settlement Agreement is attached as Exhibit A, \"subject to Court approval\"; para. 5 opens \"Pursuant to the proposed Settlement Agreement, and with the Court's approval\"; payment is conditioned on (a) an order approving the Settlement and (b) an order dismissing the Circuit Court Action with prejudice, with payment due within seven days of the dismissal order. The page therefore describes the settlement as PROPOSED, not approved or paid. No individual attorneys are named (only \"both parties having been represented by counsel\"). No EquityBuild entities, SEC, or banks appear on this page. References to the instant case: the August 17, 2018 Order Appointing Receiver (Dkt. 16, para. 8(N)) authorizing the Receiver to defend suits against the Receivership Estate — this is an order in the same case, not a precedent authority, so it is not listed under authorities or related proceedings. \"Estate of Valerie Pennington, Deceased\" is a decedent's probate estate, not a company, so it is folded into the Pennington creditor entry rather than listed as a separate organization. \"Law Division\" is a court division and is excluded. The defendants in the Circuit Court Action are referred to only as \"these defendants\" on this page (named on page 1).
